### GT save function

```{r save-func, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

### Cross conference games

```{r cross-conf-tbl, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

cross_conf_p4_2026 <- readr::read_csv("cross_conf_p4_2026.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Pull live 2026 results from the CFBD API so completed games can be scored
# and upcoming weeks (week 2 prep, etc.) stay in sync with the schedule.
cfbd_api_key <- Sys.getenv("CFBD_API_KEY")

cfbd_games_2026 <- httr2::request("https://api.collegefootballdata.com") |>
  httr2::req_url_path_append("games") |>
  httr2::req_url_query(year = 2026, seasonType = "regular") |>
  httr2::req_headers(
    accept = "application/json",
    Authorization = paste("Bearer", cfbd_api_key)
  ) |>
  httr2::req_perform() |>
  httr2::resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    home_team = homeTeam,
    away_team = awayTeam,
    home_points = homePoints,
    away_points = awayPoints,
    completed = !is.na(homePoints) & !is.na(awayPoints)
  )

# Look up a team's ESPN logo URL via cfbplotR's reference table.
team_logo_url <- function(team) {
  cfbplotR::logo_ref$logo[
    match(cfbplotR::clean_school_names(team), cfbplotR::logo_ref$school)
  ]
}

# Build a logo <img> tag; losers get desaturated + faded via `grey`.
logo_img <- function(team, grey = FALSE) {
  url <- team_logo_url(team)
  style <- ifelse(
    grey,
    "height: 26px; width: auto; vertical-align: -30%; filter: grayscale(100%) opacity(0.45);",
    "height: 26px; width: auto; vertical-align: -30%;"
  )
  glue::glue("<img src='{url}' style='{style}'>")
}

cc_p4 <- cross_conf_p4_2026 |>
  dplyr::select(-completed) |> # stale placeholder from the source csv
  dplyr::mutate(game_date = as.Date(game_date, format = "%m/%d/%y")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(week = dplyr::if_else(game_date < "2026-09-03", 0, week)) |>
  dplyr::left_join(cfbd_games_2026, by = dplyr::join_by(home_team, away_team)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(completed = dplyr::coalesce(completed, FALSE)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    home_win = completed & home_points > away_points,
    winner_team = dplyr::if_else(home_win, home_team, away_team),
    loser_team = dplyr::if_else(home_win, away_team, home_team),
    winner_pts = pmax(home_points, away_points),
    loser_pts = pmin(home_points, away_points),
    sep_symbol = dplyr::if_else(neutral_site, "vs", "@"),
    matchup = dplyr::case_when(
      # Winner (in color) + score + loser (greyed out)
      completed ~ paste0(
        logo_img(winner_team), " ", winner_pts, " - ", loser_pts, " ",
        logo_img(loser_team, grey = TRUE)
      ),
      # Not yet played: away @ home, both in color
      .default = paste0(
        logo_img(away_team),
        " <span style='font-size:9px;color:#9a9a9a;'>", sep_symbol, "</span> ",
        logo_img(home_team)
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(slot = dplyr::row_number(), .by = week) |>
  dplyr::select(slot, week, matchup) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = week,
    values_from = matchup,
    names_prefix = "week_"
  )

# Flip the table: weeks become columns, game slots become rows, ordered by
# week number (only weeks with a scheduled game get a column).
week_cols <- names(cc_p4)[stringr::str_starts(names(cc_p4), "week_")]
week_cols <- week_cols[order(as.integer(stringr::str_remove(week_cols, "week_")))]

cc_p4 <- cc_p4 |>
  dplyr::select(slot, dplyr::all_of(week_cols)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(slot) |>
  dplyr::mutate(gap = "", .after = week_3) # visual break for the Sep 20-Nov 27 gap


fball_header <- glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>2026 Regular Season Games <br>Between <em>Power</em> Conference Teams</span>
       <span style='font-size: 12px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>There are 29 games scheduled between teams of the ACC, Big Ten, Big 12, and SEC. <br>Winners are shown in color with the final score; losers are greyed out. No cross-conference games are scheduled between September 20th and November 27th.</span>
     </div>
     <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/redesign/assets/img/icons/ESPN-icon-football-college.png'
       style='height: 40px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
   </div>
  <br>"
)



cc_p4 |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = gt::everything()) |>
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") |>
  gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = gt::everything()) |>
  gt::cols_hide(columns = slot) |>
  gt::cols_width(
    gap ~ gt::px(24),
    dplyr::starts_with("week_") ~ gt::px(150)
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label_with(
    columns = dplyr::starts_with("week_"),
    fn = \(x) stringr::str_replace(x, "^week_", "Week ")
  ) |>
  gt::cols_label(gap = "") |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(fball_header)) |>
  gtUtils::gt_border_grid(color = "black",
                          weight = 1,
                          include_labels = FALSE) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::html(
    "
     data via collegefootballdata.com | cfbtxt.com<br>
     <hr>
     Four of these 29 games are at <b>neutral sites</b>: UNC-TCU in Ireland, Baylor-Auburn in Atlanta, Louisville-Ole Miss in Nashville, and Virginia-West Virginia in Charlotte.<br>
     This chart <b>excludes independents like Notre Dame.</b> The Irish are scheduled to play 10 games against power conference teams: ACC (6), Big Ten (3), Big 12 (1), and SEC (0).</br>
     <hr>
     Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )) |>
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.size            = gt::px(14),
    heading.align              = "left",
    column_labels.font.weight  = "bold"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides  = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color  = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::starts_with("week_")),
      gt::cells_column_labels(columns = dplyr::starts_with("week_"))
    )
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#F0FDF4"), # played + final
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::any_of(c("week_0", "week_1")))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_fill(color = "#FFFBEA"), # on deck
    locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::any_of("week_2"))
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(780)) -> cc_tbl

gt_save_crop(
  cc_tbl,
  file = "cc_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
)
```

### Missed connections by conference

```{r missed-connection, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

missing_matchups <- readr::read_csv("missing_conf_matchups_2026.csv")

CONF_LEVELS <- c("ACC", "B12", "B10", "SEC")
CONF_LABELS <- c(ACC = "ACC", B12 = "Big 12", B10 = "Big Ten", SEC = "SEC")


clean_conference_code <- function(conference) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    conference %in% c("Big 12", "B12") ~ "B12",
    conference %in% c("Big Ten", "B10") ~ "B10",
    TRUE ~ conference
  )
}

build_unplayed_long <- function(path) {
  readr::read_csv(path) |>
    (\(df) dplyr::bind_rows(
      df |> dplyr::select(conference, team = pair_1, opponent = pair_2),
      df |> dplyr::select(conference, team = pair_2, opponent = pair_1)
    ))() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      conference = clean_conference_code(conference),
      conference = factor(conference, levels = CONF_LEVELS)
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(conference, team, opponent)
}


build_unplayed_wide <- function(path) {
  long_logos <- build_unplayed_long(path) |>
    cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(opponent, opponent, include_name = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::group_by(conference, team) |>
    dplyr::mutate(opp_idx = paste0("unplayed_", dplyr::row_number())) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  long_logos |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(conference, team),
      names_from = opp_idx,
      values_from = opponent
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(conference, team) |>
    cbbplotR::gt_cbb_teams(team, team, include_name = FALSE)
}


fade_missed_opponents <- function(gt_tbl, opp_cols, opacity = 0.35) {
  gt_tbl |>
    gt::text_transform(
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = dplyr::all_of(opp_cols)),
      fn = function(x) {
        dplyr::if_else(
          x == "—",
          x,
          paste0('<span style="opacity:', opacity, ';">', x, '</span>')
        )
      }
    )
}

format_conf_table <- function(df, conf_code, opacity = 0.35) {
  opp_cols <- names(df) |> stringr::str_subset("^unplayed_")
  conf_label <- CONF_LABELS[[conf_code]]
  
  df |>
    dplyr::select(-conference) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gtExtras::gt_theme_nytimes() |> 
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = " ") |>
    fade_missed_opponents(opp_cols, opacity) |>
    gt::fmt_markdown(columns = gt::everything()) |>
    gt::cols_align(align = "center", columns = gt::everything()) |>
    gt::cols_align(align = "left", columns = team) |>
    gt::cols_label(team = "") |>
    gt::cols_label(.list = setNames(rep("", length(opp_cols)), opp_cols)) |>
    gt::tab_header(
      title = gt::md(paste0("**", conf_label, " Missed Connections**")),
      subtitle = gt::md(paste0("Unscheduled ", conf_label, " opponents during the 2026 regular season"))
    ) |>
    gt::cols_width(
      team ~ gt::px(60),
      dplyr::starts_with("unplayed_") ~ gt::px(50)
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      heading.align = "left",
      table.border.top.style = "none",
      column_labels.border.bottom.style = "none"
    )
}


build_all_conf_tables <- function(path, opacity = 0.35) {
  wide <- build_unplayed_wide(path)
  
  wide |>
    dplyr::group_by(conference, .drop = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::group_split() |>
    purrr::map(\(df) format_conf_table(df, as.character(df$conference[1]), opacity)) |>
    purrr::set_names(CONF_LEVELS)
}

conf_unplayed_charts <- build_all_conf_tables(
  "missing_conf_matchups_2026.csv"
)

conf_unplayed_charts$ACC |>

     Five of the 17 ACC teams play only <b>eight</b> league games, while the rest play <b>nine</b> league games.
     <br>
     <hr>
     Table by Chris at Bless your Chart"
  )) -> acc_tbl


gt_save_crop(
```
